answers.what: Deeper is a free add-on for AI chat tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini.
answers.does: It rewrites your request into a more detailed, expert-style prompt, shows it to you first, and waits for your approval before anything runs.
answers.who: It is for people who want fuller, more expert-like AI answers without knowing how to write detailed prompts themselves.
answers.next: Go to deeper.tools/start, get Deeper’s instructions, paste them into your AI chat, then type “/deeper” followed by your request.
